note: Notable systems that passed near Barbados. Closest-approach distances are approximate and compiled from public NHC and news reports for context only.

storms.name: Hurricane Beryl
storms.outcome: Passed just south as a major hurricane. Severe damage to the Bridgetown fishing fleet; roofs lost. The strongest impact in decades.

storms.name: Tropical Storm Bret
storms.outcome: Tracked across the Windward Islands just south of Barbados. Heavy rain, strong winds, widespread power outages.

storms.name: Hurricane Tomas
storms.outcome: Passed near the Windwards south of Barbados; gusty winds and heavy rain, worst damage on St. Lucia.

storms.name: Tropical Storm Emily
storms.outcome: One of the closest passes in recent memory, bringing damaging winds directly to the island.

storms.name: Hurricane Janet
storms.outcome: The benchmark Barbados disaster — passed very close to the south, killing dozens and destroying thousands of homes.
